messages:
maria (PM): Heads-up: we need to freeze scope for the cadence initiative by EOD Friday. Customer asked for tenant-level prefetch + generator integration. High-level targets: 99th < 250ms for short completions, tenant isolation, and a canary rollout plan.

aj (EngLead): Noted. Two main dependency lanes: runtime batching changes (tess) and infra prewarm + reserved slots (samir). Also storage changes for per-tenant cache eviction.

tess (Runtime): Runtime impact: continuous batching + prefix cache tweaks. I can build a compatibility shim, but will need a model-variant fallback and ~0.5 FTE for 3 sprints to stabilize. Quantized path may change output quality; will run evals.

samir (Infra): Infra asks: reserve 8 GPUs for dedicated burst + prewarm agents. Provisioning + autoscale hooks is ~2w. Need capacity signoff and finance approval for reserved pool.

olivia (Security): Quick Q: tenant isolation approach? KMS namespaced keys vs per-tenant HSMs? If we reuse keys we need extra audit instrumentation.

maria (PM): Customer prefers KMS namespaced keys (no HSM). @olivia can you confirm compliance checklist and call out blockers by Thurs?

olivia (Security): KMS namespacing is okay. Two items: (1) scrub tenant identifiers from debug logs/tokenization metadata and (2) update secrets rotation doc. I'll open a PR with checklist.

jamie (SRE): SLO/runbook: define graceful degradation. If burst exceeds capacity we fallback to smaller model variant (higher cost) and surface a "degraded" tag to customers. Need alert thresholds + runbook. @deploy-bot can we queue a canary window?

deploy-bot: Canary window request queued: /schedule canary 1974-07-01 09:00 UTC for 48h. Reply :thumbsup: to confirm.

niko (PMM): Heads-up on messaging: prefetch meaningfully reduces p95 but increases token consumption. Need clear customer-facing tradeoffs and possible pricing note.

aj (EngLead): Action items recap: - Tess: shim + fallback PR by Wed - Samir: capacity plan + reserved cost estimate - Olivia: compliance checklist PR - Jamie: SLOs + runbook draft - Maria: confirm customer KMS OK and finalize scope cutlines

maria (PM): I'll consolidate and run a 15-min alignment Fri 10:00am. Ping me if any dependency spikes earlier. Minimal example config for the runtime shim below:

```
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  tenant_mode: namespaced
  max_prefetch_tokens: 256
  fallback_model: "redwood-small-v1"
```

tess (Runtime): That config looks fine. One caveat: only switch to fallback_model when queue_time > 80ms; otherwise prefer batching. Also need a quick eval harness for quality regression.

samir (Infra): I'll drop the capacity doc here later today (will include GPU sku, cost, and autoscale hook playbook). Finance approval needed for reserved GPUs.

maria (PM): :thumbsup: Thanks team — I'll update the roadmap card with the finalized scope carveout and send the invite for Fri. If anyone wants to escalate a blocker before then, DM me.
